note: 九つ counts nine items; 九 is the abstract numeral nine (ent_seq:1578150), matching the number chín.
絨毯 and thảm can mean rugs or mats; カーペット is carpet (ent_seq:1036580), and thảm trải sàn specifies a floor carpet.
坊や is familiar and usually a small boy; 男の子 is the neutral general word for boy or son (ent_seq:1420010).
あまり also means leftovers or remainder; 余剰 is the precise surplus or excess term (ent_seq:1544260).
祝う directly includes congratulating someone and is natural for expressing sympathetic pleasure at another person's joy.
一片 and mảnh both naturally denote a separable piece or fragment of a larger whole, matching the limited definition.
オイル is common for oils and lubricants; 石油 directly means oil or petroleum (ent_seq:1382830), matching the listed petroleum sense.
モダン often suggests style or design; 現代的 is the general adjective modern or contemporary (ent_seq:1715970).
覚悟 implies serious resolve in the face of difficulty; 決意 is the general word for determination or resolution (ent_seq:1254220).
重量 is technical or formal; 重さ is the natural everyday noun for weight (ent_seq:1335760).
断定 means a definitive assertion; 結論 is the general noun for a conclusion or decision (ent_seq:1255020).
討つ is literary and often implies punishment or vengeance; 攻撃 is the general term attack, used as a suru verb (ent_seq:1279170).
判事 names a narrower judicial post; 裁判官 is the general word for a judge (ent_seq:1296130), while judiciary is a separate institutional sense.
膨大 primarily describes a huge quantity; 巨大 directly describes something physically huge or enormous (ent_seq:1232180).
The meaning is right, but 明き is a rare spelling here; 空き is the standard spelling for space, room, or gap (ent_seq:1609010).
可能性 means possibility generally; 潜在力 specifically means unrealized ability or potential ability (ent_seq:2872094).
貢献 and 寄与 describe abstract contribution to a goal, while 寄付 means donation; the broad offered addition sense has no single precise Japanese equivalent.
sự giới thiệu can mean an introduction; khuyến nghị directly means a recommendation and is attested as a noun (vn_freq rank 7204).
恥ずかしい directly covers feeling ashamed; the shame-or-guilt context distinguishes this from its separate embarrassed or shy senses.
依頼する is a natural way to commission a piece of art; the art-order context supplies the formal commission sense.
công nhân usually means a manual or factory worker; người lao động is the broader modern term for a person who works for a living.
議会 is the ordinary Japanese term for a formal deliberative assembly or legislative body, matching the definition of a diet.
伸びる directly means to stretch, extend, or lengthen when pulled; its other senses are distinct uses.
安静 suggests quiet or medically prescribed rest; 休息 is the general noun for rest or repose (ent_seq:1227940).
休める directly covers resting or suspending something and giving it relief, matching this transitive verb sense.
嬢 is a suffix rather than a standalone title, and Japanese has no neutral unmarried-woman title that matches English Miss in general use.
土俵 is specifically a sumo ring; リング is the general ring or arena term, including wrestling rings (ent_seq:1143430).
直す directly means to repair or mend something physically, and sửa chữa is the normal Vietnamese verb for repair.
Japanese distinguishes land horizon 地平線 (ent_seq:1421440) from water horizon 水平線 (ent_seq:1372060); the slash preserves the general English scope.
趣味 and sở thích both have the hobby or pastime sense of an activity enjoyed in spare time.
For a TV installment, 回 is the episode or installment counter (ent_seq:1199330) and tập is the standard Vietnamese term for an episode.
泡 can mean foam or froth; 気泡 specifically means an air bubble in liquid (ent_seq:1222620), and bọt khí is the matching Vietnamese term.
休み covers short breaks or absences; 休暇 directly means vacation, holiday, or time off (ent_seq:1227610).
移動 means movement generally; 渡り is mostly bird migration and 回遊 mostly fish migration, so the stated all-animal seasonal sense lacks one natural Japanese term.
摘む means picking something off a plant; 収穫 is harvest and is used as a suru verb for removing crops (ent_seq:1330510).
論評する means critique or review and is formal; コメント is the general noun comment, used as a suru verb (ent_seq:1051230).
気体 means gas generally; 蒸気 directly means vapor or vapour (ent_seq:1356930), matching a substance's vapor phase.
ぼやく is informal grumbling; 訴える directly means to complain or voice a grievance (ent_seq:1397720).
演習 directly means practice, exercise, or drill, matching this focused training sense.
返る is less common and often means returning to a state; 戻る is the natural general verb to return or go back (ent_seq:1535880).
